programs.description: Best friends Neelima and Aisha, who study in the same college, befriend fellow students Karthik and Kunjumon. Later, Neelima falls in love with Karthik and helps him through Aisha discreetly.
Unnikrishnan is forced to move to the city after he beats up some thugs for his foster family. In the city, he starts working for Ganapathy Iyer, a rich man who is seeking his long-lost lover.
After being forsaken by his mother in a temple, Aravindan, a five-year-old boy, is taken in by a hotelier. Against all odds, Aravindan clings to the hope of reuniting with his mother.
En route to Bangalore, a man falls in love with a beautiful girl. But he soon realises that her father was responsible for the death of his sister during a terrorist attack a long time ago.
When Unnimol, a young girl child, faces dismissal from all her relatives and community, Lord Ayyappan takes the form of a school student to help her overcome obstacles.
Madhavan Ezhuthachan's dream to establish a school in his village faces setbacks after his death, with Sudhakaran, the fund donor, struggling to make it a reality.
CID officer Chandran is murdered while working on a challenging case. Officer Nazir takes over, determined to solve both Chandran's murder and the original case.
Fate intertwines the lives of Nandan and Thara, two hearts mending from lost love, leading them to discover a second chance at happiness together.

While juggling her roles of being a great teacher and a devoted mother, a woman remains desperate for the affection she has always yearned for but never received.
A young woman faces constant torment and oppression from her family, but remains resilient in her search for love and happiness.
A father's decision to remarry brings unexpected struggles as his son Sethumadhavan steps up to care for his half-sisters, navigating shifting family relationships.
Sridevi leads a peaceful and happy life with her husband, Balakrishnan, and his siblings. However, the family faces various adversities that challenge their bonding.
Though separated, a husband and wife still love each other but hide their true feelings out of fear of rejection. They are then forced to confront their emotions or risk losing each other forever.
When the past of a middle-aged unmarried businessman confronts him, it affects his unusual romantic relationship with a younger girl.
Kalyani, who is speech impaired, is disliked by everyone in her family, except her mother. As she longs for her father's affection, Kiran enters her life.
A prince sets out on a hunt to find the diamonds that belonged to his ancestors. He faces challenges when he encounters several frauds who try to mislead him.

Sajna rejects the love of her college mate, Ameer, as she is already engaged to her cousin Anwar. However, Sajna's marriage with Anwar gets cancelled due to an unexpected turn of events.
Nathan and his wife are an unhappy couple. Things change for Nathan when his housemaid becomes close to his daughter, and he finds himself drawn to her charms.
Shakeela, who is from a rich family, marries Abdul, a poor man. Problems start brewing in their life when she comes to know that he is suffering from autism.
When Unnimol, a young girl child, faces dismissal from all her relatives and community, Lord Ayyappan takes the form of a school student to help her overcome obstacles.
A victim of an accident forgets her past and is not able to recall her identity. She falls in love with a man who provides her security and helps her start her life afresh.
Gopalakrishnan, a chef, escapes from his village to a city when his marriage gets ruined. Later, he falls in love with Radhika, but his happiness is short-lived as his past returns to haunt him.
Raji calls Latha and demands INR 5 lacs as a payoff for not revealing her father's secrets. A scared Latha employs the services of Hariharan, whose investigation throws up some startling revelations.
